title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 218 (Agent’s duty to pay sums received for principal)

content.overview: Subject to such deductions, the agent is bound to pay to his principal all sums received on his account.
content.glance: Subject to s. 217 deductions, agent must pay principal all sums received on principal’s account.
content.study: Subject to such deductions, the agent is bound to pay to his principal all sums received on his account. This is the statutory rule under Section 218 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872. Apply the elements stated in the text; do not extend beyond the provision. Read with neighbouring Agency sections as applicable. Status remains review / SOURCE_CHECK_REQUIRED pending authoritative verification.

sections.heading: Subject to deductions
sections.body: Deductions under s. 217 (advances, proper expenses, remuneration).

sections.heading: Pay all sums received
sections.body: Agent bound to pay principal all sums received on principal’s account.

provisions.title: Agent’s duty to pay sums received for principal

examples.title: Application of Section 218
examples.body: Facts that satisfy the elements stated in the statutory text of Section 218 produce the consequence described in that section. Do not add elements beyond the text.

hypotheticals.question: Do the facts engage Section 218?
hypotheticals.analysis: Compare the facts with the statutory elements in Section 218. If they match, the statutory consequence follows; otherwise it does not.

distinctions.title: Scope of Section 218
distinctions.body: Section 218 applies only to the circumstances described in its statutory text. It does not create additional grounds or remedies beyond those stated.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 218 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Identify sums received; apply s. 217 deductions; require payment of the balance.
